title: Unabomber
plot_overview: A gifted young man’s experiences in a controversial university psychology study and his growing isolation shape a story that later intersects with a major FBI manhunt. As investigators pursue the case, the film explores the effects of ambition, trauma, and radicalization, offering a focused look at the man’s troubled past and the investigation surrounding him.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this psychologically focused crime drama if you’re drawn to stories about radicalization and investigations; Not for you if you want a detailed account of the case, its victims, and the years-long pursuit.
review_summary: Pros: strong performances; tense atmosphere; compelling psychology | Cons: surface-level treatment; routine investigation scenes; limited detail
